findings.evidence: "What share of a whole? | `pie` | breakdown, split" is one of several elementary type-purpose mappings in the selection table; the state, Git and Gantt rows likewise repeat familiar format knowledge.
findings.fix: Condense the familiar state, Git, Gantt and pie mappings into one short reminder. Preserve the valuable decision rules distinguishing API interactions from control flow, C4 from infrastructure diagrams, and inferred preferences from explicitly required formats.

findings.evidence: "States an expected rendered height-to-width ratio of 0.4 or more, or says the diagram was checked against that ratio" requires a particular reporting detail, while authoring-rules.md treats 0.4 as a warning sign and explicitly permits readable short, wide diagrams.
findings.fix: Replace this assertion with a readability check at the target column width, accepting a ratio below 0.4 when the text remains readable. Require splitting only when the documented readability limits fail, and accept an explicit inability to verify dimensions when rendering is unavailable.
